AbsolutePathBuf.description:
A path that is guaranteed to be absolute and normalized (though it is not guaranteed to be canonicalized or exist on the filesystem).

IMPORTANT: When deserializing an `AbsolutePathBuf`, a base path must be set using [AbsolutePathBufGuard::new]. If no base path is set, the deserialization will fail unless the path being deserialized is already absolute.

betterCodexBackgroundTerminals.description: Present only when this running backend accepts `thread/backgroundTerminals/background` (background a running command now).

betterCodexDesktopContext.description: Present only when the host context accepts the fixed desktop module.

betterCodexDesktopTools.description: Present only when local Better Codex display tools use native sampling gates.

betterCodexHostContext.description: Present only when this running backend accepts Better Codex host context updates.

betterCodexHostContextMaxBytes.description: Present only when Better Codex host context is accepted; its total UTF-8 byte limit.

betterCodexHostContextV2.description: Present only when desktop tool guidance is gated per sampling environment.

betterCodexRevertSwitch.description: Present only when this running backend accepts `thread/revert/switch` (undo / redo a revert).

betterCodexStdioEnvironments.description: Present only when this running backend accepts Better Codex stdio environments (`environment/addStdio`, `environment/readDirectory`).

betterCodexWorkflows.description: Present only when this running backend offers the dynamic `workflow` tool and accepts `thread/workflows/stop` / `thread/workflows/list`.

codexHome.description: Absolute path to the server's $CODEX_HOME directory.

platformFamily.description: Platform family for the running app-server target, for example `"unix"` or `"windows"`.

platformOs.description: Operating system for the running app-server target, for example `"macos"`, `"linux"`, or `"windows"`.
